stem: Goal: emphasize the significance of what Ortiz recorded. Which sentence does this?
stimulus:
Notes:
• Ecologist Maya Ortiz surveyed a restored wetland in northern Ohio in 2019.
• During the survey, she recorded a pair of black terns building a nest.
• Before that pair, no black terns had nested anywhere in Ohio for more than 30 years.
choices: In 2019, ecologist Maya Ortiz surveyed a restored wetland in northern Ohio.
The terns Ortiz recorded showed that black terns now nest across all of Ohio.
The terns Ortiz recorded were the first to nest in Ohio in more than 30 years.
During a 2019 survey, Ortiz recorded black terns building a nest in a wetland.
explanation: The goal asks why the nest matters, so you need the note that gives the reason: no black terns had nested in Ohio for over 30 years. Choice C keeps that comparison with the past, and the comparison is what makes the nest significant. This is the one step behind every 'emphasize the significance' synthesis question: before you look at the choices, find the note that says why the thing matters.

A.why: You chose a sentence that says who did the survey, where, and when. All of it is accurate, but it never says why the finding matters. Saying who and when is not the same as saying why it matters.

B.why: You went past the notes. One pair nested in one wetland, and nothing in the notes says the terns now nest all over the state.

D.why: You chose the event without the comparison. Building a nest only matters because it hadn't happened in Ohio for 30 years, and this sentence leaves that part out.

stem: Goal: emphasize the achievement of the library's blood-pressure station. Which sentence does this?
stimulus:
Notes:
• In 2021, the town of Ferrisburg began offering free blood-pressure checks at its public library.
• Nurses staffed the library station two afternoons each week.
• In its first year, the station identified more cases of undiagnosed high blood pressure than the town's two clinics combined.
choices: Ferrisburg began offering free blood-pressure checks at its public library in 2021.
In one year, the library station found more undiagnosed cases than both clinics combined.
In one year, the library station ended undiagnosed high blood pressure in Ferrisburg.
In one year, the library station identified many cases of undiagnosed high blood pressure.
explanation: An achievement is a result measured against something. The last note supplies the measure: the station found more cases than both clinics put together. Choice B gives the result and the comparison, so it shows what the station accomplished. You will need this same step on synthesis questions that ask you to 'emphasize the achievement' or 'emphasize the success.'

A.why: You chose the sentence that says what started and when. That is background information, and it gives no result, so there is no achievement in it.

C.why: You claimed more than the notes support. Finding more cases than the clinics is not the same as ending undiagnosed high blood pressure in the whole town.

D.why: You kept the result but dropped the comparison. 'Many cases' could mean anything. The achievement is that the station beat both clinics combined, and this sentence leaves that out.

stem: Goal: emphasize the significance of Reyna's recording. Which sentence does this?
stimulus:
Notes:
• Folklorist Tomás Reyna collected spoken tales in mountain villages of northern Portugal in 1972.
• He recorded a tale called "The Salt Bride" as told by an 80-year-old weaver.
• Earlier collectors had assumed "The Salt Bride" survived only in printed books, with no living spoken version.
choices: Reyna's recording showed that "The Salt Bride" still survived as a spoken tale, not only in print.
Reyna recorded "The Salt Bride" in 1972 as told by an 80-year-old weaver in a mountain village.
Earlier collectors had assumed that "The Salt Bride" survived only in the pages of printed books.
Reyna's recording proved that every printed tale in Portugal was still being told aloud in 1972.
explanation: The last note sets the recording against an earlier belief: collectors thought the tale lived only in books. The recording proved them wrong, and that is why it matters. Choice A joins the recording to the belief it overturned. This is the move to make when a significance question's notes end with a background claim: the significance comes from the recording contradicting that claim.

B.why: You chose who, when, and from whom. The details are accurate and vivid, but the sentence never says why the recording mattered.

C.why: You chose the background claim alone. This sentence says what people believed but leaves out the recording that proved them wrong, so it says nothing about why Reyna's work matters.

D.why: You stretched one tale into a claim about every tale. The notes tell you about "The Salt Bride" only, not about every printed tale in Portugal.

stem: Goal: emphasize the significance of Nwosu's recordings. Which sentence does this?
stimulus:
Notes:
• In 2018, linguist Ada Nwosu interviewed the last fluent speakers of Keleo, a language spoken in a single river valley.
• She recorded about 600 hours of conversation and song.
• Keleo no longer has any fluent speakers, and Nwosu's recordings are the only audio of the language that exists.
choices: In 2018, Nwosu interviewed the last fluent speakers of a language called Keleo.
Nwosu recorded about 600 hours of Keleo conversation and song in the valley.
Nwosu's recordings have brought Keleo back as the valley's main spoken language.
Nwosu's recordings are the only audio of Keleo, which no longer has fluent speakers.
explanation: The recordings matter because nothing else like them exists, since the language no longer has any fluent speakers. Choice D says both things. Words like 'only' and 'first' usually mark the note that explains significance. Spotting them is the first step on any synthesis question that asks you to emphasize significance.

A.why: You chose the sentence that says who was interviewed and when. It describes the work but never says why the recordings matter.

B.why: You went for the impressive number. 600 hours sounds important, but size is not the reason. The recordings matter because they are the only audio of the language that exists.

C.why: You added an outcome the notes never mention. Nothing in the notes says the language has been revived. They say it has no fluent speakers left.
